title: Add a server
subtitle: One connection covers a whole server. The databases on it are discovered automatically.
copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.

engine.heading: Which database engine?
engine.hint: Choose the engine of the server you want to monitor.

postgres.name: PostgreSQL
postgres.description: Version 12 and later. Replication slots and the WAL they retain are monitored.

mysql.name: MySQL
mysql.description: Versions 8.0 and 8.4. MariaDB and older versions are refused.

endpoint.heading: Where is the server?
endpoint.name: Name
endpoint.nameHint: How this server is shown in Lockkeeper. Letters, digits, - and _.
endpoint.hostHint: DNS name or IP address, without a port or a protocol.
endpoint.databaseHint: Only the database used to open the session. Every other database on the server is discovered automatically.
endpoint.databaseHintMysql: Optional. Only used to open the session. Every database on the server is discovered automatically.

tlsHint.verify-full: Encrypts the connection and checks both the certificate and the host name. The default, and the only mode that proves you reached the right server.
tlsHint.verify-ca: Encrypts the connection and checks the certificate chain, but not the host name.
tlsHint.require: Encrypts the connection without checking who is on the other end.
tlsHint.disable: No encryption at all. Meant for a server on this machine only.

tlsWarning.verify-ca: The host name is not checked, so a valid certificate for another host would be accepted.
tlsWarning.require: The connection is encrypted but the server is not authenticated, so someone in the middle could impersonate it.
tlsWarning.disable: Traffic, including the password, is not encrypted. Remote servers refuse this mode unless you opt in explicitly.

endpoint.caPemHint: Optional. Paste it when the server uses a private certificate authority.

credentials.heading: Which account should Lockkeeper use?
credentials.intro: Use a dedicated least-privilege account, not an administrator. Create it on the server first.
credentials.passwordHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again. Pasting and password managers are allowed.
credentials.passwordSetHint: A password is already set. Leave this empty to keep it, or type a new one.
credentials.roleHeading: Account to create on the server

roleHint.postgres: Lockkeeper warns if the account is a superuser, can replicate, or lacks pg_monitor. A read-only session is not a security boundary: the account's privileges are.
roleHint.mysql: These are exactly the grants needed. Lockkeeper warns if the account can do more.

test.heading: Test the connection
test.intro: The test is read-only. It opens one session, reads the version, privileges and database list, and changes nothing.
test.staleNote: You changed the connection details after the last test. Test again before continuing.
test.errorGeneric: The test could not be run.
test.needsTest: Next is available after a successful test.
test.discoveredHint: All of them will be monitored. You do not register databases one by one.

unreachable.title: The server could not be reached
unreachable.recovery: Check the host, the port and any firewall or security group, then test again.

tls.title: The TLS requirements were not met
tls.recovery: Use verify-full with the right CA certificate. Remote servers refuse unencrypted connections.

auth.title: Authentication failed
auth.recovery: Check the user and the password. The password field is empty if it was never typed.

refused-address.title: This address is never allowed
refused-address.recovery: Link-local and cloud metadata addresses are always refused. Use the address of the database server.

review.heading: Review and save
review.intro: Check the details. The password is stored encrypted and is never shown again.
review.name: Name
review.saveFailed: The server could not be saved

errors.nameRequired: Enter a name for this server.
errors.nameFormat: Use letters, digits, - and _ only, starting with a letter or digit.
errors.hostRequired: Enter the host name or IP address.
errors.hostFormat: Enter only the host: no spaces, no protocol, no port.
errors.databaseRequired: Enter the database used to open the session.
